notes: Third phase of mapping NetApp Digital Advisor's Value Insights dashboard onto this tool. Rather than building a whole separate consolidated tab that would duplicate real data already shown, relabeled the existing Value & ROI tab's Account Snapshot panel under Digital Advisor's 4 categories: Overall Health, NetApp-Delivered Savings & Stability, Security & Future Planning, Maximize Infrastructure Value. Reuses Phase 1's computeFleetUptimeSummary() and Phase 2's computeFleetCapacitySummary() savings fields -- no new fabricated numbers. Also fixed a pre-existing sync gap found while verifying this live: index_src.html (the dev-served file) was missing the csmHealthScoreCard and csmHistoryCard containers entirely, present only in the compiled index.html -- the Account Snapshot panel never rendered at all when running via the dev server. Verified live against the real 450-system fleet.
